procedural_matters: Noa Littoz and Louis Tenconi represented FRA 7693. Yulian Degeulle and Leandre Maurey represented FRA 8798.
facts: Martin Tenconi, father of Louis Tenconi, is the support person for FRA 7693 and FRA 8798.

After the preparatory signals and before the starting signals of races 2, 3 and 4, respectively, Martin Tenconi was in the limits of the starting area of the Yellow fleet, where the boats where racing.
The jury asked Martin Tenconi to leave 4 times over the 3 starting procedures.
Martin Tenconi admitted that he was in the limits of the starting area of the Yellow fleet, where the boats where racing.

The professional coach of FRA 7693 and FRA 8798 was absent. Martin Tenconi is not a professional coach and he was replacing the professional coach. He is not used to getting the young sailors organized on the race course.
conclusions: The support person of FRA 7693 and FRA 8798 broke SI 25.4.
decision: A warning is issued to the support person of FRA 7693 and FRA 8798.
